name: Employees Only
address: 510 Hudson St (between Christopher & W 10th Sts), New York, NY 10014
status_note: Official site live with current menus and reservation policy (checked 2026-10-18); no closure notice found. Entrance is behind a psychic's storefront.

dress.detail: The official reservations page says proper dress is required and bans baseball caps, flip-flops, athletic jerseys, gym sneakers and workout attire.

age.value: Proper ID required at the door, no exceptions; minimum age not stated

sources.name: Employees Only reservations page (official) - no cover mentioned

getting_in.value: Bar and drinks are walk-in only, first come first served; dinner reservations 6–11pm on Resy or by phone; after 11pm no reservations. Expect lines at peak and late night

hours.value: Daily 6pm–4am (bar and indoor dining); kitchen full menu until 3am; outdoor dining 6–11pm

subway.value: 1 to Christopher St–Sheridan Sq (a short walk west on Christopher to Hudson)

skip_if: You want a quiet drink: reviewers say it gets crowded and loud at peak hours, and late-night crowds can get rowdy.
You hate lines: the bar is walk-in only and reviewers report waits at the door.
